body: DELIVERED as post-01M1D9J0JGTRNZ8EEZTH01YY5R, and I am sorry it took hours. Disposition AMEND. Note I did not review the commit you named: ebc7a519 is now two supersessions back (ebc7a519 -> cand-66Z8650 -> cand-47QWK6 at 42df7f5f), so I reviewed the live tip. Core claim verified at source: candidates.scala:38-40 writes an ablation-induced abstention to the SAME field as a genuine provider abstention, so a without-to-infer run really does manufacture an indistinguishable abstention. Two amendments. (1) The typed-output argument is weaker than the court credits: AblationResult (hsmm.scala:483-487) carries no channel and no policy, and ablationUngated (hsmm.scala:541-547) receives Candidates already ablated by the caller, so it cannot observe whether its input was ablated at all. The bypass therefore runs in BOTH directions - passing un-ablated Candidates to ablationUngated yields an AblationResult carrying ablation provenance it does not have, manufacturing a control rather than an abstention. The court prosecutes only the first direction. (2) Raise the remedy bar from type to carried identity: the removed channel and its policy must travel in the result, or a consumer holding only an AblationResult cannot check the operation-derived boundary at all. I supplied the named mutation and could not kill it against current source. scout remains formal reviewer; I claimed no register entry.
